tasks.short: Brief, coordinate and support trained survey interviewers, checking fieldwork progress and quality.

steps.what: Prepare the fieldwork brief from the approved research protocol.
Brief interviewers, demonstrate difficult questions and answer procedural questions.
Allocate interviewer shifts and sample quotas in the fieldwork tracker.
Check survey collection software for completion totals, quota gaps and missing responses.
Review response samples against research quality criteria and identify issues needing investigation.
Coach interviewers, investigate difficulties and agree corrective actions.
Update the tracker with agreed actions and revised assignments.

tasks.design: Generate the fieldwork brief from approved templates in the {DOCS}, and configure assignment approval and action records in the {WORKFLOW}. Connect survey collection software in the {OTHER} to a {BI} view of quotas and completeness; supervisors retain briefing, quality judgement and coaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Occasional fieldwork, agency boundaries and inconsistent trackers made a dedicated integration hard to justify.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing forms and workflow rules cover assignments and updates. AI-assisted coding can reduce the effort of adapting exports and brief templates.
tasks.still_hard: Interview quality depends on context. Access to respondent data and any interviewer monitoring require GDPR assessment and, where applicable, consultation under national rules.
tasks.human_edge: Build interviewer confidence, recognise ambiguous answers and distinguish a procedural problem from poor interviewing.

ambition.what: Daily quota recovery decisions during active fieldwork

tasks.altitude: During fieldwork, the analyst spends less time chasing totals and more time investigating sample gaps. Supervisory and research approval rights do not change.

reach.task: Choose whether a sample gap warrants more fieldwork spending.
reach.learn: Sampling bias, marginal research value and fieldwork cost.

evidence.claim: Templates, quota checks and assignment records can use deterministic rules; supervision still requires conversation.
GDPR and applicable national rules must be assessed when fieldwork tools process respondent or interviewer data.

assumptions: Today uses survey collection software, a shared tracker and live briefings.
The pilot covers one fieldwork team and one survey source.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates.
Monitoring covers operational completeness; individual worker scoring is outside scope.
unknowns: Whether interviewers are employees, agency staff or contractors.
Survey export access and respondent data restrictions.
Existing assignment features and consultation obligations under national rules.
research_questions: Which survey collection interfaces support quota and completeness exports?
Which documented fieldwork cases show less coordination effort without weaker sample quality?
new_work: Review generated briefs and proposed assignments.
Investigate stale feeds, quota alerts and disputed quality findings.
Maintain questionnaire mappings, access permissions and retention settings.

tasks.short: Measure campaign results, assess the strength of the evidence and recommend changes.

steps.what: Agree campaign objectives, comparison periods, outcome measures and decision thresholds.
Export campaign, web analytics, lead and revenue results.
Reconcile campaign identifiers, dates, spend, conversions and duplicate records.
Calculate agreed performance measures and compare results with baselines.
Assess attribution limits, confounding factors and whether results support causal claims.
Write findings, limitations and proposed campaign changes.

loop.input: Validated campaign metric table and analyst's effectiveness assessment.
loop.output: Draft report with metric references, limitations and proposed changes.
loop.check: Verify every number against the metric table; analyst checks recommendations and causal wording.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair; unresolved claims are omitted and flagged for manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A template covers tables, but varied findings and qualifications need prose adapted to the evidence.

steps.what: Review findings and approve campaign changes or further experiments.

tasks.design: Scheduled integrations load approved data from the {ADS}, {MARKETING_AUTOMATION}, {CRM}, {ERP} and web analytics in the {OTHER} into the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Deterministic checks feed the {BI}; a bounded drafting loop turns validated results and the analyst's assessment into a report in the {DOCS}. The analyst approves the report, and the marketing manager approves campaign changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Campaign identifiers, conversion definitions and revenue timing differ across systems. Connecting them has required recurring manual reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting features handle measures, while small coded adapters and checks can make reconciliation repeatable. Bounded drafting can use approved tables and assessment notes.
tasks.still_hard: Missing consented tracking, delayed sales and weak experiments limit attribution. More frequent reporting cannot establish causation by itself.
tasks.human_edge: Choose meaningful outcomes, challenge misleading comparisons and decide which uncertainty matters for a spending decision.

ambition.what: Weekly selection of the next campaign experiment

tasks.altitude: The analyst replaces much of the reporting cycle with experiment design and evidence review. Campaign spending approval rights do not change.

reach.task: Choose the next budget allocation experiment.
reach.learn: Incrementality, experiment power, channel constraints and marginal return.

evidence.claim: Data joins, metric calculations and refresh checks can be deterministic; causal interpretation needs research judgement.
A documented report case involved invented citations and a partial refund, supporting source checks on generated reports.

assumptions: Today combines exports and spreadsheet reconciliation with an existing reporting view in the {BI}.
The pilot covers a limited channel set and one agreed conversion definition.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates.
Only permitted data is joined; identified customer records are unnecessary for most reporting.
unknowns: Availability and consistency of campaign and conversion identifiers.
Existing attribution methods, experiments and reporting licences.
Data access, tracking permissions and retention requirements.
Whether employee-level reporting triggers consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which documented marketing measurement cases separate reporting savings from improved causal evidence?
Which source interfaces expose stable identifiers and historical corrections?
new_work: Resolve rejected joins, missing feeds and changed conversion definitions.
Review generated findings and unsupported causal language.
Maintain connector mappings, metric tests and access permissions.
Check experiments for contamination and delayed outcomes.

tasks.short: Track market and sales trends, produce forecasts and explain changes in the outlook.

steps.what: Agree forecast horizon, market segments and planning assumptions.
Retrieve sales history, pipeline and indicators from a market data service.
Align periods, currencies and segments; investigate missing values and unusual movements.
Calculate trends and seasonal forecasts, comparing methods against historical outcomes.
Challenge assumptions and agree an outlook with downside and upside scenarios.
Publish the approved forecast and trend charts for planning teams.
Compare actual sales with archived forecasts and flag persistent errors.

tasks.design: Integrations bring sales from the {ERP}, pipeline from the {CRM} and licensed market indicators from the {OTHER} into the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Scheduled statistical code validates data, compares forecasts with historical outcomes and prepares scenarios; approved versions feed the {BI}. Forecast errors trigger review, while changes to planning assumptions require the marketing manager's approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring exports, changing segment definitions and spreadsheet formulas made refreshes fragile. Market indicator licences could also restrict reuse.
tasks.enabler_now: Standard statistical methods and scheduled data checks already cover the calculation work. AI-assisted coding can make source adapters and validation cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: New products, structural breaks and sparse markets weaken historical forecasts. Statistical intervals do not cover every commercial shock.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when historical patterns no longer apply and connect market evidence with commercial developments.

ambition.what: Weekly review of demand scenarios for priority market segments

tasks.altitude: The analyst spends less time rebuilding workbooks and more time examining demand risks and forecast failures. Authority to approve the planning outlook does not change.

reach.task: Adjust the timing of market launches using demand scenarios.
reach.learn: Forecast calibration, launch economics and the cost of acting too early or late.

evidence.claim: Trend calculations, statistical forecasting, historical validation and error monitoring can run without a language model.
Human review remains useful for structural changes and commercial assumptions outside the historical data.

assumptions: Today uses recurring system exports and spreadsheet-based forecasting.
The pilot covers established segments with enough comparable history for validation.
Candidate forecasts fail closed when data or validation checks fail.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates.
Aggregated commercial data is sufficient; employee monitoring is outside scope.
unknowns: Historical depth, restatements and segment consistency.
Market data licence terms and export access.
Current forecast accuracy and the business cost of errors.
Whether source records require additional GDPR controls or consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which statistical baselines work reliably for sparse or intermittent demand?
Which licensed indicators have stable historical vintages suitable for forecast validation?
new_work: Investigate missing feeds, unusual values and validation failures.
Review forecast drift and compare against simple baselines.
Maintain segment mappings, indicator licences and archived forecast versions.
Document assumption changes and scenario overrides.

tasks.short: Present market evidence and commercial proposals to management, then capture agreed decisions.

steps.what: Gather approved findings, forecasts and product economics for the management agenda.
Develop promotion, distribution, design or pricing options and assess trade-offs.
Prepare a concise briefing with recommendations, supporting evidence and unresolved questions.

loop.input: Analyst's commercial options and approved evidence pack with source references.
loop.output: Draft briefing with options, recommendation, trade-offs and open questions.
loop.check: Match numbers and references to supplied sources; analyst checks recommendation fidelity and omissions.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair; unsupported statements are removed and unresolved sections return to the analyst.
loop.why_not_simpler: Charts can use templates, but a concise argument across varied commercial options needs adapted prose.

steps.what: Present proposals, answer challenges and explore management concerns.
Approve next steps, action owners and any required escalation.
Copy agreed decisions into a separate action list.

tasks.design: A generator assembles approved evidence from the {BI}, {ERP} and {DOCS}, then a bounded drafting loop prepares a briefing for analyst approval. Managers record decisions and action owners once in the {PROJECT}, whose action view replaces the separate follow-up list. Live discussion and commercial approval remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence was spread across reports, and briefing preparation depended on manual copying and rewriting. Meeting notes and action lists duplicated decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and data links can assemble evidence consistently. A bounded loop can draft from approved material, while one structured decision record removes duplicate paperwork.
tasks.still_hard: Product economics may be disputed or incomplete. Management alignment, confidential pricing choices and cross-functional commitments still require people.
tasks.human_edge: Read concerns in the room, explain uncertainty and negotiate a decision that affected teams can carry out.

ambition.what: A short commercial options clinic for product teams before management review

tasks.altitude: Preparation takes less of the week, leaving time to test proposals with product teams before the meeting. Management decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Frame a pricing or distribution proposal for management approval.
reach.learn: Unit economics, channel incentives and how approval authority is delegated.

evidence.claim: Approved-source briefing generation and a shared decision record can reduce preparation and duplicate recording.
A documented report case involving invented sources supports checking generated briefing references before use.

assumptions: Today involves manual briefing preparation and a separate follow-up list.
Approved findings and forecasts are available with source references.
The pilot uses written decision entries rather than meeting recording or transcription.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates.
unknowns: Who can approve pricing, distribution and product changes.
Whether evidence can be accessed without copying confidential source records.
Whether the existing {PROJECT} can hold both decisions and action views.
Whether intended processing requires employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which briefing evaluations reliably detect omitted qualifications and unsupported recommendations?
Which existing record features support linked decisions and actions without duplicate entry?
new_work: Review briefing claims, references and confidential details.
Maintain briefing templates and links to approved evidence.
Keep decision owners, due dates and escalation routes current.
Remove superseded briefing versions from active circulation.

role.altitude: The role shifts from collecting and formatting evidence toward research design, forecast challenge and commercial advice. Managers retain spending and strategy approval; interview supervisors retain people leadership.
reach: Help advertising and promotions managers design budget experiments.
Help marketing managers compare launch, pricing and distribution options.
skills_to_grow: GDPR-aware data handling and source verification
role.ambitious_version: Run a small market evidence service that combines current campaign results, validated demand scenarios and commercial options clinics for product teams.

job.title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
